links.outcome: LLM effect on physician diagnostic quality scores by country
links.effect: Diagnostic-step gains in Indonesia (b=7.9%, p<.001) and Kenya (b=15.1%, p<.001) but not the Netherlands (b=1.4%, p=1.00); investigative and management gains in all three countries.
links.quote: They also suggest that the extent to which LLMs can supplement physicians is context dependent.

screen.reason: The study is an RCT assessing the impact of LLM assistance (ChatGPT-4o) versus no assistance on physicians completing simulated clinical vignettes. It evaluates human-AI interaction/performance but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
